blocks.text: KEY / ACCESS CODE AGREEMENT — SHORT TERM RENTAL
This Key / Access Code Agreement is attached to the Short Term Rental Agreement dated {{agreement_date}} between {{host_name}} ("Host") and {{guest_name}} ("Guest").

rows: {{access_method}} (In-person key handoff / Lockbox / Smart lock / Keyless entry / Other)
{{code_changed_after}} (Yes / No — if Yes, new code will be provided for next guest)
{{access_method_detail}} (app code / keypad code / fingerprint / card / Bluetooth)

items: Keep all keys, access codes, and access devices secure and private.
Not share access codes or keys with any person not listed on the Short Term Rental Agreement.
Not duplicate, photograph, or record access codes for use after the rental period.
Use the access method only as instructed. Do not force, probe, or tamper with locks, lockboxes, or smart lock mechanisms.
Lock the property securely upon each exit and at check-out.
Return all keys at check-out (if key handoff).
Not change the lock, lock code, or access settings.
Report lost or stolen keys / compromised codes immediately to Host.
If lockbox code or smart lock code is compromised, Guest is responsible for the cost of changing the code and any resulting locksmith or re-coding charges.

blocks.text: If a key is lost or an access code is compromised during the rental period:

items: Guest must notify Host within 1 hour of discovery.
Host will arrange for key replacement, lock re-coding, or lockbox code change.

Guest is responsible for all costs: key replacement ({{key_replacement_cost}}), lock re-coding ({{lock_re_code_cost}}), locksmith call-out ({{locksmith_fee}}), lockbox replacement ({{lockbox_replacement_cost}}).
If access is lost and the Vehicle/property cannot be accessed, Guest may need to arrange alternative accommodation at Guest's expense.

blocks.text: Host may enter the property under the following conditions:

items: Emergency: Immediately, without prior notice (fire, flood, gas leak, security threat, injury, or other urgent safety concern).
Non-emergency maintenance/repair: With at least {{notice_hours}} hours notice, during reasonable hours ({{entry_hours}}).
Between-guest turnover: Host or cleaning crew will access the property after checkout and before the next guest's check-in. This is not considered a violation of Guest's privacy.

blocks.text: Guest acknowledges having read, understood, and agreed to this Key / Access Code Agreement. Guest confirms receipt of the access method and agrees to the responsibilities listed above.
